character: A big, steep mountain in the Teton Range above Teton Village, with an aerial tram to the summit of Rendezvous Mountain and one of the largest lift-served verticals in the US. Much of the terrain is advanced, with easier groomed runs and learning areas lower down near the base.
learning: Reference note: learning lifts and carpets sit at the Teton Village base, with the easier Apres Vous area as a step up; lessons run through the resort's mountain sports school. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.
